text:
Elena: Heads-up — seeing a small but consistent spike where idle client probes trigger a route flip and tenants get a tiny billing bump :confused:
Ben: repro steps?
Elena: connect to ws edge, let connection be idle ~60s, client sends idle probe, then proxy flips to fallback route for a few seconds. billing shows +0.0001 tokens. logs attached below. :eyes:
Ben: can you paste the logs?
Elena: 
```
2025-12-10T14:22:59Z INFO conn=xyz idle_probe recv
2025-12-10T14:23:00Z WARN conn=xyz route_change from=primary to=fallback reason=probe_timeout
2025-12-10T14:23:01Z INFO billing tenant=tenant-42 delta=0.0001 event=frame_start frame_meta="probe"
```
Nina: ah okay — probe frames are being classified as normal frames at the frame_start hook. that should be excluded from metering.
Ben: yep. meter currently counts on frame_start regardless of header. proxy isn't tagging probe frames specially.
Jordan: is this purely metering, or does routing logic also treat probe as "activity"?
Elena: routing flip happens because probe arrives during a short control window and triggers our sticky-lease fallback. so two problems: probe looks like activity (routing) and looks like billable payload (metering).
OpsBot: alert: increased streaming-credit usage for tenant-42 detected at 2025-12-10T14:23:05Z (spike +3%).
Nina: proposed fix: add a short header X-RW-STREAM-PROBE: 1 for probe frames at edge client layer, update proxy to treat that header to bypass billing and avoid changing session affinity. also add a span tag probe=true to telemetry.
Ben: agree. minimal changes: (1) accept header in edge nginx layer, pass through; (2) in meter service, early-return if probe header present; (3) in routing, don't treat probe frames as lease-renew events.
Jordan: can we ship as a canary? i.e., enable on 10% of edge nodes first. need flags in config and a console toggle for rollout.
Elena: also console UX: our session timeline currently collapses these probe events so graphs don't show correlation vs billing. we should expose a "probe" event on the timeline and a debug filter.
Nina: i'll open a PR with the header + meter exclusion and a small change in the routing state machine. PTAL. /assign @Nina :hammer_and_wrench:
Ben: test plan: synthetic client that idle for 60s, sends a probe with header, assert: (a) route does not flip, (b) billing delta==0, (c) traces include probe=true tag.
Elena: also add a telemetry metric probe_count and probe_billed_count to catch regressions. add dashboard tile next to streaming credits. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Jordan: ops question — will older clients (no header) regress to previous behavior? yes, so default path must preserve current semantics. rollout must be opt-in per tenant while we patch client libs.
Nina: plan: default behavior unchanged; new header opt-in. client SDKs (js/python) will ship new flag. we'll coordinate deprecation later.
Deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary config update (#5678) — waiting approvals.
Ben: once canary is up, we'll run synthetic tests against canary and control for 24h. if probe_billed_count==0 and no route churn, we promote.
Elena: one more: add a note in the console rollout UI explaining why probe events matter for billing — customers keep asking. short blurb + link to docs.
Jordan: thanks everyone. keep this thread updated with PR and canary results.
Elena: thanks — tracking in #eng-platform runbook as well.
